english.note: Use this when the restriction is specifically an explicit rule or regulation rather than a general limitation.
Use this when the standard means an imposed rule or requirement, especially one set by an authority.

examples.english: There is a restriction on bringing outside food into the venue.
examples.traditional: 入場有規定，唔准帶外來食物。
examples.jyutping: jap6 coeng4 jau5 kwai1 ding6 m4 zeon2 daai2 ngoi6 loi4 sik6 mat6

examples.english: The new government standard requires all restaurants to install fire extinguishers.
examples.traditional: 政府嘅新規定要求所有餐廳都要加裝滅火筒。
examples.jyutping: zing3 fu2 ge3 san1 kwai1 ding6 jiu3 kau4 so2 jau5 caan1 teng1 dou1 jiu3 gaa1 zong1 mit6 fo2 tung4
